correctness.rationale: The source's discrete-time progression parameter gamma is a probability (0<gamma<1); Section 5's equation q*gamma=pc*((beta1+p*beta2)/(1+p))^2 consequently imposes beta1+p*beta2<B=(1+p)*sqrt(q/(pc)). With beta1<B the strictly feasible beta2 interval is (0,(B-beta1)/p). Substitution into R0a=beta1/delta + p*beta2/gamma gives derivative q(1+p)^2*(beta1-p*beta2)/(c*(beta1+p*beta2)^3), so beta2*=beta1/p is feasible iff 2*beta1<B. For B/2<beta1<B the entire nonempty feasible domain is increasing and has only a boundary supremum. Exact rational witness p=q=1/2,c=1,beta1=1,delta=1/2 has 0<beta2<1, source optimum beta2=2 would demand gamma=16/9, and supremum R0a=5/2. The independent checker re-derived all identities symbolically; the proof handles all positive parameters and the equality 2*beta1=B excludes the strict boundary optimum.

value.rationale: The probability-domain restriction changes the source's unrestricted evolutionary assertion: an open and physically valid parameter regime has no lawful interior virulence optimum even though the printed derivative has one. It changes admissible model interpretation and mathematically distinguishes strict-probability supremum from an attained unconstrained optimum. The original Figure 3 parameter set lies in the feasible regime, so that particular figure is not overturned. This is more than a cheap sign check because it locates and characterizes a consequential parameter-domain failure.
